description.short_caption: Modified acid-fast stain showing a red-stained oocyst in stool.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a modified acid-fast stain of a stool sample. A single oval-shaped oocyst is prominently stained red against a blue background, indicative of an acid-fast organism. The surrounding material appears granular and blue, consistent with debris and background staining. The staining technique highlights acid-fast organisms, which retain the red dye due to their waxy cell walls.

description.short_caption: Modified acid-fast stain of stool specimen showing oocysts.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a modified acid-fast stain of a stool specimen. The background is blue, with numerous round to oval structures stained bright pink to red, consistent with acid-fast oocysts. The contrast between the blue background and the red-stained organisms highlights their presence. This staining technique is commonly used to identify coccidian parasites such as Cryptosporidium species.
visible_findings: numerous round to oval red-stained structures (oocysts)
